newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet on Friday, with no sales of slaughter steers and not enough heifer sales for an adequate market test, USDA said in its roundup report.
Confirmed: 100, last week: 3800, last year: nil.

USDA said inquiry and demand was fair on Friday. Feedlots were very current. Sales were confirmed on 100 slaughter heifers Friday. Sales confirmed last week on 72,600 head included 12,600 head or about 17 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter heifers: couple loads Select with end Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 69.50.
